visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: The Prefix Is Cut from the Front
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The common prefixes should be fl and inter, but the program prints two empty lines.

solution.explanation: A prefix keeps its beginning, so a candidate that fails is shortened from the end (slice(0, -1) drops the last letter). slice(1) drops the first letter, which can never produce a prefix of the words.
